rationale: The agent located the user and identified the relevant order (#W5565470) delivered to Texas, and initiated returns for two items while excluding the pet bed as requested. However, it failed key policy requirements: it did not explicitly confirm the order-changing action before submitting the return, it did not provide the requested tracking number, and it made an unsupported/likely incorrect statement that the pet bed “will remain with you” despite indicating the order was delivered to Houston, TX. These issues violate the confirmation and correctness requirements, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
